title: Multivariate Spatio-Temporal Neural Hawkes Processes
summary: We propose a Multivariate Spatio-Temporal Neural Hawkes Process for modeling complex multivariate event data with spatio-temporal dynamics. The proposed model extends continuous-time neural Hawkes processes by integrating spatial information into latent state evolution through learned temporal and spatial decay dynamics, enabling flexible modeling of excitation and inhibition without predefined triggering kernels.
